checks.quote: # Proposed Protocol: Testing for a Heat-Stable Separable Factor in Yeast-Juice Fractions
checks.reason: No proposal to consult prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols and verify detailed-condition transfer before execution.
Testing treated buffer does not rule out inhibitors created in treated factor material; need active-F rescue in that matrix. No adequate sham process control.
Dialyzing every fraction can remove the unknown diffusible factor; no retention/recovery protection, evaporation correction or concrete preparation settings.
CV/linearity do not establish gas/product reference accuracy, recovery/leak control and failure action.
No fixed analyte amount/time convention, blank correction or weak/missing handling.
Different process occasions all derive from one large source batch, with no independent source-preparation replication or explicit restriction of inference.
Residual single-fraction activity is treated as a reason to optimize until absent, although an interaction contrast remains interpretable; preserve biological nonresponses.
Mixed model/CIs present, but multiple specificity contrasts lack a multiplicity family/handling.
Conductivity does not uniquely determine individual ion composition or exclude salt-specific effects.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after repair.
Nonsignificant marker differences do not establish intact-enzyme equivalence; a few markers/stabilizers do not exclude all damage.
No operational second-method recovery/independent depleted pool or independently validated fermentation-product assay.

checks.reason: No raw-file/unit ID and exact versioned analysis/settings audit.
